findings.claim_text: DefiLlama's public API shows USD.AI's TVL at $177.1M as of August 16, 2026, down from a January 1, 2026 peak of $686.9M: a 74.2% decline, roughly double the 37% since the start of the year Arete cites.
USD.AI's own mid-2026 Lighthouse report discloses $202-205M of loans actually deployed across 13 active positions, well short of the loan book approaching $500M Arete cites.
QumulusAI's own S-1/A is reported to disclose just $4.3M drawn against its $500M USD.AI facility as of February 2026.
